# `memory` — `/api/memory`

Memory router — Arynwood's long-term memories: create, edit, delete, confirm a model-written (provisional) memory, and review proposed revisions.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/memory`](#get-api-memory) | Return all Arynwood memory entries, pinned first then newest first. |
| POST | [`/api/memory`](#post-api-memory) | Insert a new memory entry and return the created row. |
| PUT | [`/api/memory/{memory_id}`](#put-api-memory-memory-id) | Update an existing memory entry by ID. |
| DELETE | [`/api/memory/{memory_id}`](#delete-api-memory-memory-id) | Delete a memory entry by ID. |
| POST | [`/api/memory/{memory_id}/confirm`](#post-api-memory-memory-id-confirm) | Mark a model-written ('provisional') memory as reviewed and trusted. |
| GET | [`/api/memory/{memory_id}/revisions`](#get-api-memory-memory-id-revisions) | Every proposed revision of a memory, newest first. |
| POST | [`/api/memory/{memory_id}/revisions/{revision_id}/accept`](#post-api-memory-memory-id-revisions-revision-id-accept) | Apply a pending revision. |
| POST | [`/api/memory/{memory_id}/revisions/{revision_id}/reject`](#post-api-memory-memory-id-revisions-revision-id-reject) | Reject a pending revision; the memory is left as it is. |

<a id="get-api-memory"></a>
### `GET /api/memory`

Return all Arynwood memory entries, pinned first then newest first.

- Handler: [`list_memories`](../../../backend/routers/memory.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Response**

- `200`: JSON list of rows of `arynwood_memory`: `id`, `type`, `title`, `content`, `pinned`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `status`, `volatility`, `conflict_with_id`, `project_id`, plus `pending_revision`

<a id="post-api-memory-memory-id-confirm"></a>
### `POST /api/memory/{memory_id}/confirm`

Mark a model-written ('provisional') memory as reviewed and trusted.

Arynwood's system prompt tells it to write <remember> blocks proactively, and chat.py saves every one automatically — this is the human-in-the-loop step that turns "the model claimed this" into "the user confirmed this," without which a hallucinated fact would be indistinguishable from a real one the next time it's re-injected into a system prompt.

- Handler: [`confirm_memory`](../../../backend/routers/memory.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `memory_id` | path | integer | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: a row of `arynwood_memory`: `id`, `type`, `title`, `content`, `pinned`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `status`, `volatility`, `conflict_with_id`, `project_id`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 404 | Memory not found | `confirm_memory` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |

### `POST /api/memory/{memory_id}/revisions/{revision_id}/accept`

Apply a pending revision. The memory becomes confirmed; 409 if it changed since the revision was proposed.

- Handler: [`accept_revision`](../../../backend/routers/memory.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `memory_id` | path | integer | yes |  |  |
| `revision_id` | path | integer | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `accepted`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 404 | Memory or pending revision not found | `accept_revision` |
| 409 | This memory changed since the proposal. Review a new revision. | `accept_revision` |
